text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Fuchu Umamusume Stakes arrived.
Although Tokyo Racecourse was buzzing with excitement—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, they're going to Kyoto!?
To watch the Shuka Sho? Whoa, I'm so jealous!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah~. Will Kawakami Princess
take the Double Tiara undefeated...
or will another girl win? It's thrilling again this year!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, come to think of it... Daring Heart's
running in today's race too, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: I feel like last year's Triple Tiara races were pretty exciting too, but...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
...Still, to think only Heart is left.
It feels kind of...—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: —I won't let you say you're lonely.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daring Heart murmured softly.
As if she was trying to convince herself.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: If I run... If I can embody running together with everyone...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"The passion of those days becomes the passion of now.
And it will carry forward into the future."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Then I... will believe in my own running too.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: If I can awaken everyone's passion today—I'll know for sure that the path I chose wasn't a mistake.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
""Oh, it's Heart." "Right, now she's..."
"Out of all those rivals... she's the only one left, huh?"
"—Must feel lonely.""

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(It's fine for now. That's fine.
I'll make them remember—with my running!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Those days I loved so dearly――
I won't let my youth come to an end...!
